query: SELECT e.value->>'role_id' AS "role!", count(DISTINCT i.id) AS "n!" FROM invites i CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(i.project_roles) e WHERE i.org_id = $1 AND i.accepted_at IS NULL AND i.revoked_at IS NULL AND i.expires_at > now() AND jsonb_typeof(e.value) = 'object' AND e.value->>'role_id' IS NOT NULL GROUP BY e.value->>'role_id'
